description: Resume a suitable existing workspace and resolve ambiguous creation before adding a duplicate.
human_review_requirements: reuse: The decision selects task-42 based on current task identity, required content and host evidence; it resolves the ambiguous create outcome without retrying creation, taking over old-task-42, or allocating a worktree to the read-only reviewer.
